An email match identifies its recipient alias’s website, not a verified sender. SMS source clues are uncertain and do not prove a data leak.
Paste an SMS, or share one into LeakTrace from your messages app.
Local checks analyze only the message you select, paste or share. Optional inbox reading stays on this device. No SMS is uploaded automatically.
This is a simple heuristic check, not proof that a message is safe or fraudulent. Verify requests through a trusted app, website, or phone number you found independently.
Paste or share a message before analyzing it.
Enter a message and tap Analyze locally. Links will be shown as text, not opened.
No valid http, https, or www link was found in this message.
This check only recognizes a few common patterns. A message can still be unsafe.
Urgent wording can discourage you from checking a request independently.
The message mentions a locked, blocked, or suspended account or unusual activity. Confirm it through the provider\'s official channel.
Request for a code or sensitive details
The message asks for a password, one-time code, PIN, card number, or banking details. Do not share these in a reply or an unverified page.
A fee, payment, or prize claim can be used to rush a decision. Check the offer independently.
This link uses HTTP instead of HTTPS. HTTPS alone would not prove a link is safe either.
A shortened link hides its final destination. Verify the request before opening it.
The link uses an IP address instead of a recognizable domain name. Verify it independently.
An @ sign in a link can put a familiar name before the real destination. Check the address after @ carefully.
Checked without signing in: each feature\'s address is requested and the reply shows whether this server provides it.
A mobile-capable server can pair this device with your existing LeakTrace account.
LeakTrace has no SMS inbox, contacts or email permissions. Account data uses the paired mobile API. SMS text is sent only after you explicitly request server comparison.
Account data is private. Pair this device through the LeakTrace web dashboard on a mobile-capable server.
Checking whether this server has an account route.
Sign-in is not available in the app
This server requires a paired mobile device to load private account data.
This server restricts account access to its own computer. The app cannot connect an account here.
Account access is not on this server
The account route was not found. There is no Android sign-in available here.
The server did not provide a usable account status. Check the connection above and try again.
Checking which data routes this server provides. No account records are being loaded.
Data route availability could not be confirmed. Try the server check again above.
No websites, emails or timeline events can be loaded without an authenticated account. These labels show route availability only; they are not your data.
